summary: The parts of SecurityInsight that are reachable from the internet now hold only the rights they need, and a short network fault no longer stops a scheduled wake-up.

fixes.title: The web app holds only needed rights
fixes.text: The web app and MCP server identities keep only the rights for their own data, checked on every update. Until the next version, Run now, stopping a run, schedule changes and template releases show a message; scheduled runs continue.

fixes.title: Short database network faults are retried
fixes.text: When the connection to the database fails for a moment while it is being set up, SecurityInsight tries again after a short wait instead of stopping the run.
